title: OKR Check-In Freshness
dataSources: Habit activity (`lifeos:habit`), streaks (`lifeos:streak`), Beeminder goals (`lifeos:beeminder`), OKRs (`lifeos:okr`), planning syncs (`lifeos:ops`).
app: Personal life-OS telemetry — Habitica quest logs, Streaks app habit chains, Beeminder goal data, and personal OKR reviews — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lifeos:okr objective_name=* last_checkin_epoch=* snapshot_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((snapshot_epoch-last_checkin_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by objective_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures OKR check-in freshness by objective for OKR reviews.
value: Lag tracking shows which objective create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside OKR reviews.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `OKR check-in freshness` on `lifeos:okr` events and aggregate them by `objective_name`.
visualization: Table of objective with average and worst OKR check-in freshness.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how long things take for each objective so you can see where OKR reviews slows down.
